patterns.note: Content sections utilize an asymmetrical two-column grid where section labels are left-aligned and content blocks are right-aligned, creating a visually distinct structure.

The hero section features an extremely large, decorative serif font for the main statement, creating a strong visual anchor, contrasted with a clean, understated sans-serif for all other text and navigation.
The design uses a stark, high-contrast palette of black text on a very light, almost white, background, emphasizing readability and a minimalist aesthetic.
The site header, containing the name 'Tom Sears' and navigation links, remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Each content section is clearly delineated by ample vertical whitespace and introduced by a small, uppercase sans-serif label aligned to the left.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the screen, providing persistent navigation and branding while the main content scrolls underneath.
Content sections are presented in a two-column grid where section labels are left-aligned and content blocks are right-aligned, creating an asymmetrical but balanced layout.

A dramatic, oversized decorative serif font is used for the primary hero statement, creating a strong visual impact, while all other text uses a clean, understated sans-serif for readability and contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized decorative serif hero (~5-6x body) with small, understated sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero and section breaks, balanced within content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and dramatic use of oversized, decorative serif typography in the hero section, which immediately establishes a strong, editorial tone. This is powerfully contrasted with a minimalist layout and generous whitespace, creating a sophisticated and memorable personal brand statement.
